per_task_results.example_semantics: For task_id 203 at epoch 1, different samples include success=false with io_passed=5/io_total=10 and success=true with 10/10; success therefore tracks all-IO pass in the observed rows.

memory_snapshots.semantics: Committed strategy arrays provide exact frozen memory state for the evaluated replay cells.

trajectory_example.transport_observation: The public Git object is immutable but gzip/non-UTF8. The current scheduled-Chat GitHub text connector rejects direct blob/content fetch as non-UTF8, while the directory metadata is readable. Do not count this as a Chat-readable row-level grade transcript.

aggregate_verifier.arc_cells_mapping: Checks n_rows, n_success, acc_mean and acc_std from per-task rows for the ARC cells table; metadata fields such as n_samples/n_tasks are not outcome checks.

semantics: The grader runs generated solve code on all shown examples plus held-out test_examples.
A task passes only when every example passes.
The sandbox records got and expected per example and defines correctness as exact Python equality: got == ex.output.

verifier_and_grader.static_replay_boundary: Aggregate n_rows/n_success/mean/std can be recomputed from the committed plain-text per-task rows without model execution. But validating each success bit against got/expected requires either the packed gzip grade transcript to be available through a Chat-readable text route or deterministic candidate-code execution. The current scheduled-Chat text connector cannot read the gzip blob, so full row-level outcome verification is not accepted.

row_level_outcome_verification.blocker: grade got/expected transcript is packed in gzip/non-UTF8 artifact inaccessible to the current scheduled-Chat repository text route; recomputing by executing generated code would be a different execution path, not static replay.

memory_construction_replay.blocker: memory-update path uses hosted models (task gpt-5.4-mini / script memory model gpt-5.2) and the retrospective package does not bind provider-side original run identity/randomness sufficiently for execution-time nonrepudiation.

packaging_fix: Publish an unpacked UTF-8 JSONL grade ledger keyed to immutable per-task row identity, including extracted candidate-code hash, every got/expected pair, error, all-pass reduction and trajectory blob hash. Then the scheduled-Chat route can compare got/expected and recompute success/aggregates without executing generated code or consuming hosted quota.
scope_guard: Do not infer that the gzip transcript is absent; it exists as an immutable public Git blob. The finding is specifically that this scheduled-Chat text transport cannot inspect its non-UTF8 payload in the tested route.
